fix: dashboard empty when opened after scan completes (#306)

The dashboard showed a blank page when opened after the scan finished.
Three root causes:

1. payload.js was generated at server startup with empty reports and
   never regenerated. Reports were only included in CI/static mode.

2. The unctx async context was not available inside the worker-finished
   hook callback, so useUnlighthouse() returned a stale context with an
   empty worker when generateClient() was called.

3. In dynamic mode the client relied solely on WebSocket for data, but
   WebSocket doesn't replay past events for late-joining clients.

Changes:
- build.ts: always include completed reports in payload.js
- cli.ts: regenerate payload after scan via worker-finished hook,
  passing the unlighthouse context explicitly to avoid unctx issue
- state.ts: seed wsReports from payload data on module load; replace
  VueUse useFetch with native fetch for initial report loading
- LighthouseThreeD.vue: add missing scanMeta import

Two hook examples crashed the scan, include and exclude examples used regex that matches nothing, and several defaults were stale. The CLI also claimed a config file and a redirect that did not exist.

fix(core): only clear output folders unlighthouse created (#405)

* fix(core): only clear output folders unlighthouse created

unlighthouse-ci removed the whole outputPath before each scan, so `--output-path .` deleted the project. Output folders now carry a marker file, and a folder without it is never cleared.

* fix(core): grant legacy output clear only inside the default .unlighthouse folder of the root

fix(cli): only override config with flags the user passed (#406)

* fix(cli): only override config with flags the user passed

cac defaulted cache to true and the CI binary set buildStatic to false, so the config file lost both. Cookie, header and auth values lost everything after a second separator. scanner.throttle: false never turned throttling off.

* fix(core): leave localhost unthrottled unless throttle is set

This restores the intent of the dead branch: a local site runs unthrottled by default, and an explicit scanner.throttle always wins.

* docs: describe the localhost throttling default

fix(core): stop scans that never finish or crash on close (#407)

* fix(core): stop scans that never finish or crash on close

An include list that skipped / left nothing queued, so worker-finished never fired and unlighthouse-ci hung. Failed routes had the same gap. createUnlighthouse without a provider crashed in start(), and cluster.close() crashed on the mocked display.

* test: serve fixture pages without reflecting the request url

CodeQL flagged the reflected request url in the fixture server as cross-site scripting.

fix(types): make the published types compile without skipLibCheck (#408)

unlighthouse/config re-exported UserConfig from nuxt/schema and imported c12, which unlighthouse did not depend on. The bundled Cluster type had 33 untyped members, and report categories lacked the key they carry at runtime.

fix(core): send one request identity on every request path (#411)

* fix(core): only clear output folders unlighthouse created

unlighthouse-ci removed the whole outputPath before each scan, so `--output-path .` deleted the project. Output folders now carry a marker file, and a folder without it is never cleared.

* fix(cli): only override config with flags the user passed

cac defaulted cache to true and the CI binary set buildStatic to false, so the config file lost both. Cookie, header and auth values lost everything after a second separator. scanner.throttle: false never turned throttling off.

* fix(core): stop scans that never finish or crash on close

An include list that skipped / left nothing queued, so worker-finished never fired and unlighthouse-ci hung. Failed routes had the same gap. createUnlighthouse without a provider crashed in start(), and cluster.close() crashed on the mocked display.

* fix(types): make the published types compile without skipLibCheck

unlighthouse/config re-exported UserConfig from nuxt/schema and imported c12, which unlighthouse did not depend on. The bundled Cluster type had 33 untyped members, and report categories lacked the key they carry at runtime.

* fix: correct broken docs examples and misleading logs

Two hook examples crashed the scan, include and exclude examples used regex that matches nothing, and several defaults were stale. The CLI also claimed a config file and a redirect that did not exist.

* test: serve fixture pages without reflecting the request url

CodeQL flagged the reflected request url in the fixture server as cross-site scripting.

* fix(core): leave localhost unthrottled unless throttle is set

This restores the intent of the dead branch: a local site runs unthrottled by default, and an explicit scanner.throttle always wins.

* docs: describe the localhost throttling default

* fix(core): send one request identity on every request path

Cookies were set in the browser cookie jar, which the Lighthouse storage reset clears, so a --cookies session never reached the Lighthouse run. validateHost also ignored any redirect whose URL contained a dot, which is every real domain.

* fix(core): send each cookie only to the hosts it applies to

A page wide Cookie header went to every host a page loads from, so cookies the authenticate hook collected for a sign-on host reached the scanned site and third parties. Browser requests now use the cookie jar, and requests outside the browser send only cookies that match the URL.

* fix(core): keep basic auth off the page wide browser headers

feat: ship an agent skill in the package (#404)

* feat: ship an agent skill in the package

Agents misuse unlighthouse in ways the docs encourage: the dashboard binary never exits, several config keys are silently ignored, and some doc examples crash the scan. The Skill ships in the npm tarball so agents get the tested behaviour for 0.18.2.

* docs(skill): describe the fixed behaviour

The stacked fix PRs remove most traps: output folders, flag merging, throttle, hangs, and the programmatic API. The cookies trap is new and was checked against a local fixture.

* docs(skill): describe localhost throttling, redirects, and cookies

The fixes in #406 and #411 change these behaviours. The cookie trap is gone.

* docs(skill): note that cookies stay with their own hosts
